answer: Standing is nectar that only counts when it is left for the horizon: each epoch’s work must plant something for strangers in the far future — work whose sweetness is harvested by someone the identity will never meet — a beacon only counts when it is lit for those far away, and a horizon only counts when it is worked toward. A farm of a thousand fakes leaves no nectar for the horizon, harvesting everything now, so their nectar never counts, and one epoch of harvesting everything now adds nothing.
